plan_a: Elves combo-aggro: flood the board with mana-elves (Heritage Druid, Nettle Sentinel, Fyndhorn/Llanowar Elves, Quirion Ranger), chain them into Glimpse of Nature to draw your deck, then finish with a huge Craterhoof Behemoth overrun or Green Sun's Zenith / Natural Order for it. Wirewood Symbiote + Visionary generate value. Gaea's Cradle makes explosive mana. Go wide, then go tall and swing.
plan_b: Mono-White Death & Taxes: deploy taxing hatebears (Thalia, Mother of Runes, Phyrexian Revoker) and grind on tempo. Lock their mana with Rishadan Port + Wasteland, protect creatures with Mother of Runes, and suit up a threat with Stoneforge Mystic -> Batterskull/Jitte. Swords to Plowshares removes their threats. Attrition and mana-denial win; don't race combo, disrupt it.
